headline: House resolution to end the national emergency on Libya, declared in 2011, failed in a July 2023 vote.
what_it_does: This joint resolution would have ended the national emergency concerning Libya that President Obama declared on February 25, 2011. National emergency declarations like this one give the President special legal powers, often used to impose sanctions such as freezing property. Ending the emergency would have removed the legal basis that relies on this specific declaration.

who_it_affects.group: People and organizations subject to Libya-related US sanctions
who_it_affects.how: Restrictions tied to this emergency declaration, such as frozen property, would have lost the legal basis this declaration provides.

who_it_affects.group: The President and federal agencies that enforce sanctions
who_it_affects.how: They would no longer have been able to use the special powers tied to this particular emergency declaration.
